channel.title: The AI Ledger
channel.description: Daily AI intelligence, read by Maya and Adam. Private feed.
channel.itunes:author: The AI Ledger

item.title: 28 Nov: US Compute Curbs Reach Southeast Asia
item.description: Nvidia halts server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries as US cloud-access rules bite. Also: Trainium3's inference margin beats Nvidia's GB300, and 42 attorneys general fight the sale of Character.AI chats.
item.itunes:summary: Nvidia halts server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries as US cloud-access rules bite. Also: Trainium3's inference margin beats Nvidia's GB300, and 42 attorneys general fight the sale of Character.AI chats.

item.title: Fri 27 Nov: FCC clears SpaceX orbital data centres
item.description: The FCC licensed SpaceX to put up to a million AI data-centre satellites in orbit. Also: the Nasdaq 100 fell into bear-market territory, and Amazon and Meta negotiate over the Muse shopping agent.
item.itunes:summary: The FCC licensed SpaceX to put up to a million AI data-centre satellites in orbit. Also: the Nasdaq 100 fell into bear-market territory, and Amazon and Meta negotiate over the Muse shopping agent.

item.title: 26 Nov: AI Writes Landmark Math Proofs
item.description: Anthropic and OpenAI post AI-written proofs of landmark complexity results. Also: the FCA says firms own their agents' risks, and Amazon reports agents exploiting a zero-day in eleven minutes.
item.itunes:summary: Anthropic and OpenAI post AI-written proofs of landmark complexity results. Also: the FCA says firms own their agents' risks, and Amazon reports agents exploiting a zero-day in eleven minutes.

item.title: Wed 25 Nov: Lab Insiders Say Models Too Risky
item.description: Axios reports staff at Anthropic and OpenAI doubt their best unreleased models can be shipped safely. Also: Sierra raises $1.75B at a $30B valuation, and MiniMax admits its scanners opened customers' URLs.
item.itunes:summary: Axios reports staff at Anthropic and OpenAI doubt their best unreleased models can be shipped safely. Also: Sierra raises $1.75B at a $30B valuation, and MiniMax admits its scanners opened customers' URLs.

item.title: 24 Nov: Washington helps Huang return to Nvidia
item.description: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO with Washington's blessing. Also CrowdStrike's $43.9B deal for Zscaler and US banks fencing in their AI agents.
item.itunes:summary: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO with Washington's blessing. Also CrowdStrike's $43.9B deal for Zscaler and US banks fencing in their AI agents.

item.title: Mon 23 Nov: Claude-assisted Riemann proof machine-certified
item.description: Lean and Mathlib certify the Claude-assisted Riemann hypothesis proof. Also: three AI inference providers breached, and server makers repricing signed AI deals by up to forty-five percent.
item.itunes:summary: Lean and Mathlib certify the Claude-assisted Riemann hypothesis proof. Also: three AI inference providers breached, and server makers repricing signed AI deals by up to forty-five percent.

item.title: Sun 22 Nov: Claude-assisted Riemann proof claimed
item.description: A Claude-assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis is claimed and under expert review. Also: Anthropic falls 11% on its second trading day, and Congress discloses 879,000 AI chip approvals for Chinese firms.

item.title: Sat 21 Nov: Anthropic's raise grows, then slides
item.description: Anthropic's IPO grows to about ninety-three billion dollars before shares slide on day two. Also: OpenAI gates router access to its models, and Apple, Google and Replit push agents that run whole computers.

item.title: Fri 20 Nov: Anthropic trading and agent safeguards

item.title: Thu 19 Nov: Anthropic IPO and bank agents
